reviewer: independent subagent (read-only, no private data) - NOT the code author's review path

findings.finding: PASS/PARTIAL verdicts have no independent direction/magnitude oracle: source-oracle months valid are 0/105 for JT, GH and EW, 45/105 for LowVol; completion never requires direction; EW control PASS rests on reconciliation + same-author review only. Protocol PASS text demands audited direction/magnitude.
findings.myVerification: VERIFIED_BY_ME (public result files: sourceSpreadValidMonths; build-completion-v3.mjs control branch)
findings.proposedFix: Amend verdict rules (post-result amendment, must be labelled as such) or downgrade; strict reading of the pre-registered text gives NOT_CERTIFIED / INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCE_DATA

findings.finding: LowVol NEGATIVE source-spread direction comes from the 45 months with complete data; FRENCH_VAR reference is POSITIVE; conflict not flagged; sign read from SOURCE_GROSS only.
findings.proposedFix: Direction conflict with reference forces PARTIAL with reason; publish valid-month fraction and exclusions by reason

findings.finding: Freeze import closure follows only literal imports; return-series.js, canonical-total-return.js, published-close.js (loaded via require(path.join(...))) are not hashed, so 'UNCHANGED_FROZEN_LOADER_SPLIT_VALIDATION' does not bind the split code.
findings.proposedFix: Add those files to CONTRACT_FILES; test that every require(path.join(...)) target is in freeze.files

findings.finding: A position without a bar is held at its last close indefinitely (no haircut, no staleness limit); active listings whose data ends early get no terminal; 52W diagnostics show positions without bar on 2175 of 2198 days.
findings.numericReviewCatches: not caught (R8 re-marks at the same last close)
findings.proposedFix: Hard check that every ending position has a bar within K sessions or a terminal; publish stale-hold counts

findings.finding: Quarantine terminal date uses the quarantine 'from' date, which can precede the observation date; names are removed from ranking from 'from' with information that arrived later; data-quality quarantine receives the 0.7 delisting factor.
findings.numericReviewCatches: not caught (R6 only checks fill date equals terminal date)
findings.proposedFix: terminal.date = max(from, observedAt) or next session; mutation test

findings.finding: R8 takes book.dividends as given (circular); R2/R9 calendar and benchmark checks are tautologies because the calendar is the SPY dates; off-calendar security bars are dropped with their dividend/split fields and not published.
findings.proposedFix: R8b recompute dividends from replayed holdings; gate and publish off-calendar counts

findings.finding: Signal formation not reviewed: formationDates come from the run under test; no recomputation of scores/ranks/cohort weights and no truncation (lookahead) test.
findings.proposedFix: Truncation test and an independent scorer for JT/GH/LowVol

findings.finding: Dust ledger cancels the reconciliation gap by construction for deleted residuals; threshold is 1e-10 shares not value-aware; reviewer experiment hid 10 dollars at an absurd price.
findings.proposedFix: Hard cap on summed dust mark value; dollar threshold

findings.finding: R10 (adjusted price level over 1e6) is INFO only; 74 securities affected, 58 traded in the JT top book; the data finding stays OPEN while protocol demands no unresolved general critical bug.
findings.proposedFix: Pre-registered sensitivity run with and without these names; openFindings input to completion

findings.finding: build-completion-v3.mjs: referenceOk true for any COMPUTED/PARTIAL report with no parity check; trusts self-reported review status; no hardChecks/book-list check; duplicate summaries last-wins; single generic NOT_CERTIFIED reason.
findings.proposedFix: Require 11 hard checks per expected book, reject duplicates, split reason codes

findings.finding: Universe is observed-only (9,410 of 15,564 listing generations); drop reasons not public; calibration has no price/liquidity floor unlike the tournament universe; -30% baseline without calibration sensitivity.
findings.proposedFix: Publish count-only tables by terminal kind/year/drop reason

findings.finding: Reconciliation tolerance scales with final equity; guardedNumericCash can mint up to the proven bound; calibration does not reuse published-close.js (ADR-002 deviation).

frozenBeforePerformance is a literal flag set by the measuring runner; createdAt is hashed so each run has a new freezeId; execution/review code changed after earlier public summaries were visible (infrastructure-only per evidence, not machine-verifiable).
findings.proposedFix: External timestamp/commit pinning of the freeze before measurement

findings.finding: No tickers, security ids or performance fields found in calibration/*.json; low-grade quasi-identifiers exist (one price level, one cost figure, one date, one dust value in discrepancy/diagnostic records).

noBlockingDefectFound: fill pricing and costs (synthetic-bar fix complete)
cash never negative (R3 bound; leverage throws)
split factors applied cumulatively backward; two canonical rejections fail closed

claimBoundary.strictReadingOfPreRegisteredText: NOT_CERTIFIED with reason INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCE_DATA (PASS requires audited direction/magnitude which the oracle could not provide; arithmetic-only evidence cannot lift a control)
claimBoundary.effectiveStatement: construction mechanics reconcile and pass a same-author separate-path review; they are NOT validated against an independent stock-level magnitude/direction oracle
